Name: MS Windows Print Spooler Remote Code Execution (PrintNightmare)
Synopsis: The Windows Print Spooler service allows remote authenticated users to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges.
Solution: Apply the security update referenced in Microsoft KB5004945 or disable the Print Spooler service on servers that do not require printing.

Name: MS17-010: SMBv1 Remote Code Execution (EternalBlue)
Synopsis: The SMBv1 server on the remote host has multiple remote code execution vulnerabilities.
Solution: Apply the MS17-010 patch and/or disable SMBv1 entirely; use SMBv2/v3 instead.

Name: Windows MSHTML Platform Security Feature Bypass
Synopsis: A security feature bypass exists in the Windows MSHTML platform.
Solution: Install the applicable Windows Update to address CVE-2024-30040.

Name: Sudo Heap-Based Buffer Overflow (Baron Samedit)
Synopsis: A heap-based buffer overflow in sudo before 1.9.5p2 allows local privilege escalation to root.
Solution: Upgrade sudo to version 1.9.5p2 or later via the distribution package manager.

Name: OpenSSL Infinite Loop Denial of Service (BN_mod_sqrt)
Synopsis: OpenSSL's BN_mod_sqrt() function can be made to loop forever with a malicious certificate, causing a denial of service.
Solution: Upgrade OpenSSL to the patched version provided by the distribution's package manager.

Name: Cisco IOS XE Web UI Privilege Escalation
Synopsis: A vulnerability in the web UI feature of Cisco IOS XE Software could allow an unauthenticated attacker to create an account with privilege level 15 access.
Solution: Disable the HTTP/HTTPS server feature on internet-facing devices or apply the vendor-provided fix per Cisco's advisory.

Name: Apache Log4j2 Remote Code Execution (Log4Shell)
Synopsis: The order-processing application bundles a vulnerable version of Apache Log4j2. An unauthenticated attacker can trigger remote code execution by causing the application to log a crafted string (JNDI lookup injection).
Solution: Upgrade the bundled Log4j2 library to 2.17.1 or later; do not rely on mitigations like removing JndiLookup.class as a permanent fix.

Name: SSL Certificate Expiry
Synopsis: The SSL certificate for this service expires within 30 days. An expired certificate will cause browsers to show trust warnings and may break automated clients that validate certificate expiry.
Solution: Renew and replace the SSL certificate before its expiration date via your CA or ACME automation.

Name: Deprecated TLSv1.0 and TLSv1.1 Protocol Detected
Synopsis: The remote service accepts connections encrypted using TLS 1.0 and TLS 1.1, both deprecated protocols with known cryptographic weaknesses (e.g. BEAST, POODLE-adjacent issues).
Solution: Disable TLSv1.0 and TLSv1.1 in the web server's TLS configuration; support TLSv1.2 or later only.

Name: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS GlobalProtect Command Injection
Synopsis: A command injection vulnerability in the GlobalProtect gateway/portal feature allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges by creating a crafted file on the system.
Solution: Apply the PAN-OS hotfix referenced in Palo Alto Networks advisory PAN-SA-2024-0010
Port: or disable GlobalProtect gateway/portal telemetry as an interim mitigation if the hotfix cannot be applied immediately.
